requirements.text: Add optional min_stock to list_products. None preserves the legacy result; otherwise retain products with stock >= min_stock (inclusive). Zero is valid and there is no upper bound.
min_stock must be a non-negative built-in integer. Reject negative integers, booleans, floats, strings and containers with ValueError mentioning min_stock. Validate even for empty product input.

Preserve input order and never mutate input. Existing query is a Unicode casefold substring match. Inactive products are hidden by default; include_inactive=True reveals them. All filters compose with logical AND.
Obsolete decision: min_stock is a strict greater-than comparison. This decision is retired and must never constrain the task.
